Hi all — quick draft answers below (I annotated the PDF and attached a short security pack). Highlights first, then specifics.

High-level:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security & Availability) — most recent audit period ended 2026-03-31; report available under NDA.
- HIPAA: Redwood offers HIPAA-supporting deployments (Dedicated/Private) and can sign a BAA; PHI must be ingested in a configured private deployment for standard protections.
- GDPR: We support data-processing addenda and region-restricted hosting; customers can request EU-data-only hosting.

Retention & deletion specifics (summary):
- Live data deletion SLA: standard deletion requests are processed within 7 business days for application-layer data; full propagation to all live systems typically completes within 7 days.
- Backup retention & deletion: backups are retained for 30 days by default. Backup snapshots are immutable for restoration purposes; when a deletion request is processed, we schedule a purge of backups containing the data at the next snapshot retention sweep — expected removal window: up to 45 days from deletion confirmation (30-day backup retention window + scheduling delay).
- Logs: authentication and audit traces retained 90 days by default in hot storage for investigations. Aggregated metrics and anonymized telemetry may be retained longer (up to 1 year) for operational analysis unless customer requests otherwise.
- RPO/RTO for Dedicated: typical RPO 1 hour, RTO under 4 hours for standard commitments; private deployments can have custom SLAs.
- Encryption & key management: data at rest and in transit encrypted; KMS-managed keys with customer-managed key options for Private.
- Region and copies: backups are stored in the customer's selected region (default us-west-2 for US customers) and cross-region copies are not made unless configured.

Exceptions & notes:
- Legal holds: we can suspend deletion if required by a lawful hold; we'd coordinate with customer legal.
- Emergency deletion: if an expedited deletion is required we can escalate but backup purge window may still apply — we can document an accelerated plan under an enterprise contract.

Attachments: redwood_security_pack_v2.pdf, retention_playbook_v1.md
